name: Tatenokawa Tsumuri
source:
Magia: Ice Engraver, an ability that allows the user to turn water into ice and manipulate the shape of the ice as it forms.  

Tsumuri is a young genius and a magia researcher... and her first love after research is her kotatsu, followed by Leeruxu and sweets. 

[spoiler] Tsumuri mother is called Minori. She does research because she wants to learn about her mother dies [/spoiler]
